verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs mention building dashboards and reports [pigment-docs-28], collaborating through shared views, permissions and notifications [pigment-docs-27], and fine-grained data access rights that control who can see and modify specific data [pigment-docs-15]. Together these imply scoped sharing of reporting content, but none of the evidence shows a dashboard-sharing workflow in depth; the MCP-specific access scoping is about AI assistants, not dashboard sharing, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: an explicit documented flow for sharing dashboards or reports with specific users or groups, board or external-viewer access with read-only scoping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
